sources.locator: Introduction, paragraphs beginning The Azores Current originates and East of the Mid-Atlantic Ridge: Grand Banks origin, MAR crossing, eastward jet and distinct recirculation/branches.
sources.supports: Approximate Grand Banks branch origin, MAR crossing and eastward continuation; recirculation and countercurrents distinct.

sources.citation: Martins et al. (2002), Surface circulation in the eastern North Atlantic, from drifters and altimetry, doi:10.1029/2000JC000345.
sources.locator: Section 3.3.2 and Figure 3: 34-36 N eastward flow toward Gulf of Cadiz; seasonal position/width inference inconclusive.
sources.role: Eastern regional continuation; no drifter axis digitized.

sources.citation: Comas-Rodriguez et al. (2011), The Azores Current System from a meridional section at 24.5 W, JGR Oceans 116, C09021, doi:10.1029/2011JC007129.
sources.locator: Abstract and section 2: 2009 meridional survey; 110 km widths and separate eastward/westward currents.
sources.role: Section context only; width is not along-current length and is not applied along the route.

source_access_note: Frazao 2022 and Martins 2002 full text retrieved. Comas-Rodriguez 2011 exact section context is already retained in the audited width inventory and indexed primary-source text; direct full-page/PDF fetch failed this turn, so no new curve or field extraction is claimed.

naming_gates.gate_role: All selected regional approach conventions; not whole-system or diagnosed exact endpoints.
naming_gates.branch_exclusions: Gulf Stream/North Atlantic upstream branches, north/south counterflows, southward recirculation and Canary/Gibraltar downstream routes.

measurement_guards: 110 km is a 2009 meridional section width for each opposing current, not either current length.
Do not apply section width uniformly along the reference corridor.
1871-2010 model core analysis and study-domain bounds do not define a contemporary full-current route.
Transport and front migration do not provide length/width confidence or annual extrema.

seasonal_evidence.support: 1993-1994 drifter seasonal position/width analysis inconclusive due to irregular and insufficient sampling.

countercurrent_guard.reason: Westward subsurface counterflow requires its own endpoint/layer/time conventions; no mirrored parent route.

data_access_leads.product: SODA-POP v2.2.4 monthly fields 1871-2010, 0.5 degree output
data_access_leads.status: Paper description only; data not acquired or validated for monthly geometry here.
